definitions: A formal written or verbal notification given to an employee that their employment is being terminated due to reasons such as restructuring, downsizing, or lack of work, rather than for performance-related issues.
The document or communication informing an employee of an impending layoff.
examples: She received a layoff notice yesterday.
Many workers got their layoff notice via email.
The company issued a mass layoff notice.
He dreaded getting a layoff notice.
